notes:
This leaf gives a diagram of exact rows with vertical maps and Galois identifications. It states that the kernel J of the map from the generic to the integral group maps isomorphically to inertia I_s-prime, canonically isomorphic to T. It then describes the section induced by the rational point, its inertia map into pi by a composition with mu times the identity, and the resulting image in the normalizer of L_i. The last D’ailleurs is an unfinished continuation. These are descriptions of what the page states, not verified mathematical results.
The whole image was viewed once and each full-resolution half once; every word, formula, deletion and insertion was compared with both witnesses. Eighteen distinct saved Pillow crops were inspected once after the overview. They use original boxes recorded in this report, autocontrast, LANCZOS resizing to 2200 pixels wide, and sharpening. No OCR, text recognition, other leaf, or external research was used. No mathematical proof, computation or independent use was performed; check_events is empty. The count is 16 prose rows plus five diagram object ranks, excluding the supralinear additions and marginal folio.
The header and most wording follow C. Both equals-sign short forms are resolved locally from two horizontal levels, with no m. The two Gal identifications use oblique simeq signs, not upright parallel bars: their curved members occupy opposite sides, retained by locally rotated TikZ signs. The tiny barb on the top diagram map supports an arrow with medium confidence; the short maps in the prose and the local map T-pi retain their bare shafts. Hom.-lacets is supported against both witnesses, including its separate hyphen and final t/s. The point description and group-decomposition phrase remain insertions in their observed positions. The three kappa/k forms remain explicitly ambiguous; neither alphabet is rejected, and C is placed first only for continuity. The cancelled subscript in the overwritten diagram node and the final cancelled parenthesis remain doubtful. The unchanged live I in the inertia sentence is retained even though the earlier kernel is corrected to J. No author question mark or new mathematical doubt is visible on this leaf. The diagram macro stands at text level without an external display-math wrapper; no compilation was run.
